scope: Conventional subcutaneous lispro kinetics in adults with T1D; adjacent model ancestry retained separately.

pilot.purpose: Confirm API access and query translation before main export; no full screening yet.

queries.query: (lispro[Title/Abstract] OR Humalog[Title/Abstract]) AND (kinetic*[Title/Abstract] OR absorption[Title/Abstract] OR pharmacokinetic*[Title/Abstract] OR compartment*[Title/Abstract] OR model*[Title/Abstract])

("type 1 diabetes"[Title/Abstract] OR "type I diabetes"[Title/Abstract] OR "type-1 diabetes"[Title/Abstract] OR T1D[Title/Abstract]) AND insulin[Title/Abstract] AND (subcutaneous[Title/Abstract] OR "continuous infusion"[Title/Abstract]) AND (model*[Title/Abstract] OR kinetic*[Title/Abstract] OR variability[Title/Abstract])
(TITLE_ABS:lispro OR TITLE_ABS:Humalog) AND (TITLE_ABS:kinetic* OR TITLE_ABS:absorption OR TITLE_ABS:pharmacokinetic* OR TITLE_ABS:compartment* OR TITLE_ABS:model*)

(TITLE_ABS:"type 1 diabetes" OR TITLE_ABS:"type I diabetes" OR TITLE_ABS:"type-1 diabetes" OR TITLE_ABS:T1D) AND TITLE_ABS:insulin AND (TITLE_ABS:subcutaneous OR TITLE_ABS:"continuous infusion") AND (TITLE_ABS:model* OR TITLE_ABS:kinetic* OR TITLE_ABS:variability)

screening.deduplication: PMID, then DOI, then provider accession; preserve provider and query memberships.
screening.population: Adults T1D separable; mixed/unclear material is background or unresolved, not presumed eligible.
screening.unavailable_full_text: Retain unresolved if plausibly primary; never infer parameters from an abstract.
screening.numerical_target: Known development material; no untouched empirical validation claim.
screening.citation_tracing: Two documented rounds from included model families; targeted further tracing for new essential ancestry.
screening.corrections: Exact source identity and correction/retraction indicators checked at closure.

date_filter_note: PubMed explicit 1800-01-01 lower bound spans its relevant historical holdings; Europe PMC uses 0001-01-01. No recent-year restriction.
